name: telegram-bot
description: Telegram Bot API: read updates, send messages, photos and documents, edit and delete messages, answer button presses, manage the webhook

nodes.title: Get Telegram updates
nodes.description: Fetch new messages, button presses and other updates by long polling. Pass next_cursor back as cursor (or store it with state-store); it also confirms the updates already received. Fails while a webhook is set.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call (last update_id + 1)

offset.description: Raw getUpdates offset instead of cursor; negative values read from the end of the queue

long_poll_seconds.description: Long-poll seconds to wait for updates (0 = return at once; sent as `timeout`)

allowed_updates.description: Update types to receive, e.g. ["message","callback_query"]; [] = all except chat_member and reactions; omitted = previous setting

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send Telegram message
nodes.description: Send a text message to a chat, optionally formatted, as a reply, silent, or with an inline/reply keyboard. Never resent automatically.

parse_mode.description: Formatting: MarkdownV2, HTML or legacy Markdown

disable_link_preview.description: Do not show a link preview

reply_to_message_id.description: Reply to this message id in the same chat

protect_content.description: Prevent forwarding and saving of the sent message

reply_markup.description: Keyboard, e.g. {"inline_keyboard":[[{"text":"Yes","callback_data":"yes"}]]}, a reply keyboard, {"remove_keyboard":true} or {"force_reply":true}

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

has_spoiler.description: Cover the photo with a spoiler animation

nodes.title: Set Telegram webhook
nodes.description: Send the bot's updates to an https URL instead of get_updates. Sends TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET (if set) as the X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header value. Node only.

url.description: https URL that receives updates (ports 443, 80, 88 or 8443)

allowed_updates.description: Update types to receive, e.g. ["message","callback_query"]; [] = all except chat_member and reactions; omitted = previous setting

ip_address.description: Fixed IP address to send to instead of resolving the host

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
